description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Server_System, which provides system.* methods for an XML-RPC server, such as listing methods, providing method help, signatures, and multicall functionality.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server_System
classes.description: Provides system-level XML-RPC methods such as listing all methods, retrieving method help, signatures, and processing multicalls for a given XML-RPC server.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of all available XML-RPC method names.

methods.name: methodHelp
methods.description: Returns help information for a specified XML-RPC method.

methods.name: methodSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of a specified XML-RPC method.

methods.name: multicall
methods.description: Executes multiple XML-RPC method calls in a single request, returning their responses or fault information.
